column2: when using WCN7850 or QCN9274 as AP

column1: grade phy mode operation regardless of whether the firmware supports EHT
capability or not and then vdev will start in HE mode. When stations that
support EHT capability try to connect to the AP
column2: the AP will set phy mode

column1: to EHT after receiving the association request packet
WMI_PEER_ASSOC_CMDID command to firmware
This is because when the ath12k_mac_copy_sband_iftype_data() function
handles EHT capability
column2: it does not copy the EHT capability into the

column1: iftype[band][type] array according to the interface type. So
type should not be used as an index to get eht_cap in
ath12k_mac_check_down_grade_phy_mode() function.
To address this issue
column2: use types_mask to select the eht_cap in

column1: ath12k_mac_check_down_grade_phy_mode() function.
This patch affects QCN9274 and WCN7850 because they have the same issue.
